title: feat(nm2frm2sms): directed 2-step cyclic-frame transport along +e2 at t+1 on two-axis same-lock seed: reverse fails, face fails
science: Same-lock +e2 2-step. Its not-leftover gate is a genuine cross-computation: it recomputes the same-lock -e3 one-step (HOLD) and the (0,0,0) two-step inside this runner and asserts they differ from the +e2 result, so the runner independently reproduces #7630's reverse HOLD.
